title: Non-anchor position-period prediction follow-up
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-only period target before adding or scoring any candidate key material. It does not reuse public anchor-derived additive fragments as discovery evidence or primary evidence.
prediction_target: Future independently obtained non-anchor K4 position observations should fall into predeclared residue classes for the registered period set before any candidate-word, route, or key-material scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Registered period set selected before evaluation
Deterministic residue-class emission rule fixed before observing new evidence
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
A committed held-out non-anchor position set not derived from public anchors
